thread:
maria_pm: Quick sync — planning the security/compliance launch for BYOK + SLA. Need a compatibility matrix for customer keystores: AWS KMS (CMK + external), GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, and HSM import flows. Also define retention SLA tiers (30/90/365/7yr) and SOC2 evidence requirements. Who owns initial inventory and gating criteria?

raj_engineer: I can own the compatibility matrix. Will need a list of handshake endpoints and supported algos from product. Will add fields: import_mode (online/offline), attestation_required, rotation_support, export_format.

sam_security: Heads up — for HSMs we need attestation proof + signed cert chain. Also confirm whether hardware-backed keys are allowed for export; legal constraints may block certain regions.

julia_sales: FYI from field — BankCorp and SmallTrustFS requested 7yr retention + WORM + searchable audit exports. They explicitly asked about SLA for evidence retrieval during e-discovery.

kevin_cse: Adding customer nuance: offline import (physically provided key blob) and rotation-window guarantees are common asks in finserv. They also want audit-export to S3/GCS with presigned links and zstd-compressed bundles.

lee_sre: For SLAs, propose: warm-search retrieval P95 < 2s, legal-hold cold retrieval < 60s, audit-export generation < 5m for <1000 audit records. These have infra cost implications (indexing vs cold archive).

maria_pm: Good. Proposed launch gating: 1) compatibility matrix completed + owners 2) keystore integration tests green (unit + e2e) 3) SOC2 artifact mapping + playbook 4) performance validation against SLA under realistic load 5) legal sign-off on export/crypto jurisdiction.

raj_engineer: I'll sketch a CSV schema and start populating tomorrow. Sample columns: provider, import_mode, algos, attestation, rotation_api, key_lifecycle, export_formats, test_playbook_link.

sam_security: I'll put together a security checklist doc: attestation requirements, key handling, access control matrix, and recommended mitigations for tenant-scoped key leakage.

legal_bot: Noted. Please include country-of-origin and allowed-export flag per keystore entry so legal can triage export control.

kevin_cse: For pilot customers, we should offer an explicit rollback plan: fallback to managed keys + audit-only mode. Customers will expect a canary with explicit SLA reduction warnings.

maria_pm: Canary plan: stage 1 internal-only with synthetic traffic, stage 2 invited-customer pilot (3 customers), stage 3 general availability. Rollout gates: no critical security findings, SLA perf within 10% of target, and export format validated.

raj_engineer: Quick sample handshake snippet I will use in matrix for clarity:
```
POST /keystore/handshake
{
  "provider": "aws",
  "mode": "external",
  "cert_chain": "...base64..."
}
```

julia_sales: Can we track which sales opportunities require the 7yr retention flag? I'll add a deal-tag in CRM if we can map it to a launch tier.

lee_sre: Ops note — index retention for fast retrieval costs ~3x vs cold archive. Need to include cost estimates per tenant SLA tier in the matrix.

maria_pm: Action items: Raj -> matrix by Tue EOD (1745634835), Sam -> security checklist + attestation template by Wed, Legal -> export flag review by Thu, Lee -> perf/SLA validation plan + cost estimates. Kevin/Julia -> customer pilot shortlist. I'll collect all and schedule a 30m gating call Friday.

deploy-bot: Reminder: release freeze for compliance bundle on Thu 23:59 UTC :warning:

raj_engineer: Acked. I'll drop the initial CSV link in #eng-infra and ping here when ready.

sam_security: Also adding a short threat model and acceptance criteria to the checklist (tamper evidence, chain-of-custody, access auditability).

maria_pm: Thanks all — let's keep updates in this thread. If anyone is blocked, call it out early. :thumbsup:
